judged_text: The migration builds its INSERT with Ruby string interpolation of the raw setting value (`'#{h}'`) instead of a quoted/parameterized SQL value. A crafted embeddable_hosts setting value containing a single quote (the old setting accepted free text lines) produces a malformed SQL statement and aborts the migration, breaking the deploy; it also permits SQL injection through the setting value.

adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration copies the old setting into the new table via raw SQL built with string interpolation: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, ...)"`. `h` is sourced directly from `site_settings.value` and split by newlines, with no quoting/escaping. A value containing a single quote would generate invalid SQL and abort the migration, and because it is executed as SQL text it also creates an injection vector via the stored setting value.
